% A second test for tex8web: a document unlike the notes, to check what
% it handles without a config of its own. No xcolor, packages that MathJax has
% as extensions, xparse macros, equation numbers by section, and titling's
% title with a \thanks.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb,physics,braket,cancel}
\usepackage{titling}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\numberwithin{equation}{section}
\NewDocumentCommand{\prob}{m}{\mathbb{P}\left(#1\right)}
\NewDocumentCommand{\dist}{O{2} m m}{\lVert #2 - #3 \rVert_{#1}}
\newcommand{\cond}[2]{#1 \,\middle|\, #2}
\title{Generic}
\author{Someone}
\date{A day\thanks{A note on the date.}}
\begin{document}
\maketitle
\section{One}
Unnumbered.
\section{Two}
Text with $\prob{\cond{A}{B}}$, $\dist{x}{y}$ and $\dist[\infty]{x}{y}$, and
from physics $\dv{f}{x}$, $\abs{x}$, $\qty(\frac{a}{b})$, from braket
$\braket{\phi|\psi}$, and from cancel $\cancel{x}$.
\begin{equation}\label{eq:a}
    \prob{X > t} \le \frac{\mathbb{E}X}{t}
\end{equation}
\begin{align}
    a &= b + c \label{eq:b}\\
      &= d \nonumber\\
    e &= -f \label{eq:c}\\
    g &= h \tag{$*$}
\end{align}
\begin{gather}
    x = y \\
    z = w \notag
\end{gather}
See \eqref{eq:a}, \eqref{eq:b} and \eqref{eq:c}, which should read (2.1),
(2.2) and (2.3), followed by (2.4) for $x = y$.
\end{document}
